scope: Windows-program execution and full instrumented suite at the new target SDK.

windows_program.result: runs as its own process via the shim linker route; stable 150 s; no session teardown

instrumented_suite.result: all pass at target 35, same count as at target 28

manifest_readiness.foreground_service_types: dataSync (Steam/Epic/GOG services), specialUse|dataSync (SessionKeepAlive); ChatOverlayService does not call startForeground so needs no type; AppLocalesMetadataHolderService is AndroidX metadata

methodology_note: An apparent loss of backslashes in boot_exe (C:windowssystem32notepad.exe) was an adb test-harness artefact: adb passes shell arguments to the device sh, which strips unquoted backslashes. splitCommand, the app quoting and the shim's sh -c exec wrapper were each verified to preserve them. Drive Windows paths through a device-side single-quoted script.
limitations: notepad is a Wine built-in; a real Steam game launch needs an account and downloaded content, which is the phone/field gate.
Emulator + software Vulkan; nothing here is an Adreno result.
